e7_s4_rationale: The histologic examination demonstrated a pleomorphic tumor composed of three distinct cell types, which is consistent with a mixed germ cell tumor, a type of testicular cancer that contains more than one type of germ cell tumor component.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Non-seminomatous germ cell tumor
e7_s4_rejected.why: While possible, this diagnosis is too broad and does not specifically account for the presence of multiple distinct cell types.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Seminoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Seminomas are typically uniform in cell type and do not usually present with the pleomorphic pattern described.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Embryonal carcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Embryonal carcinomas can be part of a mixed germ cell tumor but alone do not explain the presence of three distinct cell types.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Spermatocytic tumor
e7_s4_rejected.why: Spermatocytic tumors are rare and typically have a distinct histological appearance that does not match the pleomorphic pattern with three distinct cell types described in the case.

B07_pred: Mixed Germ Cell Tumor; Non-Seminomatous Germ Cell Tumor
